create_controller_from_config: create a Controller instance from a ControllerConfig, Scene, and View using create_controller factory method
run_controller_game_loop: run the Controller game loop that handles update, render, tick, and user input steps
set_controller_scene: set a new Scene on an existing Controller instance using the set_scene method
set_controller_view: set a new View on an existing Controller instance using the set_view method
review_controller_abstract_methods: review the Controller abstract base class and its required subclass methods for the game loop
